(a) Interlocks shall remain in the safety circuit with door panel(s) separately secured in closed position on the hoistway side.

(b) Eliminate the capability of automatic elevators from opening the car doors at the floor placed out of service.

(c) Egress, Accessibility and Firefighters' Emergency Operation.

(d) Associated labeling and signaling shall be removed.

Delete and revise Subsection (c) of Section 8.7.2.13 to read as follows:
previewText: (a) Interlocks shall remain in the safety circuit with door panel(s) separately secured in closed position on the hoistway side.
